description: This Dart file implements a Flutter widget for a Home screen in a mobile application. It includes visual components such as cards, statistics, charts, and navigation elements, designed with pixel-precise layout matching Figma designs. The file defines a primary StatelessWidget, auxiliary widgets, and engages with app routing and assets.

classes.name: HomeScreen16454
classes.description: Main widget implementing the home screen with pixel-perfect layout, interactive cards, statistics, charts, and navigation components.

classes.name: _VisaPart
classes.description: Helper widget to display visa asset images within card components.

classes.name: _LegendRow
classes.description: Widget to display a colored legend dot with label, used in chart legend.

classes.name: _Bar
classes.description: Small widget representing a vertical bar used in the chart representation.

methods.name: buildBigCard
methods.description: Builds a large gradient payment card, with decorative assets and tap interaction.

methods.name: buildSmallCard
methods.description: Builds a smaller version of the payment card with decorative elements.

methods.name: buildStatCard
methods.description: Creates a statistical info card with title and amount, and a chart stripe.

methods.name: buildHeader
methods.description: Builds the header bar including title, back navigation, and search icon.

methods.name: buildAddCardPill
methods.description: Creates a pill-shaped button to navigate to add a new card.
